builtInHelp: {name} ships with Eidolon. Your edits are saved in your data home, and the original stays as it is.
source.template: This is {name}'s built-in file. Saving keeps your copy in your data home and leaves the original unchanged.
editor.leaveBody: Your unsaved changes will be lost.
avatar.title: Avatar
avatar.description: This is her avatar, on the call page and in the persona switcher. Click it to upload one from your files, or drop a picture on it.
avatar.note: An avatar is optional but recommended.
avatar.builtIn: Her avatar is built in. Upload one to use your own instead.
avatar.removeBody: The picture is deleted from her folder, and her initials show in its place.
identity.title: Identity
identity.description: Who she is, as the built-in prompts and the call page name her. Write the names in her language.
identity.name: Name
identity.nameHelp: Her full name, as the prompts say it.
identity.shortNameHelp: What she's called for short. Her initials come from it.
identity.summaryHelp: One English sentence about her. The retrieval gate reads it to tell when a question is about her.
identity.missing: She needs a name and a short name.
timezone.title: Time zone
timezone.description: Her clock: the date and time she knows during a call.
prompt.title: Prompt
prompt.description: The system prompt: who she is, how she talks and the rules she keeps. Calls that start after you save use it.
prompt.label: System prompt
prompt.missing: This persona has no prompt yet. Write one and save it.
voice.title: Voice
voice.description: The Fish Audio voice she speaks with. Search the public voices, listen to a sample, and pick one.
voice.note: Choosing a voice saves it for {name}.
voice.inherited: Inherited from {env} in the environment. Picking a voice here overrides it for {name} alone.
voice.inheritedBroken: Fish Audio can't use the voice she inherits from {env}. Pick her own below.
voice.noneHelp: A call needs one: pick her voice below.
voice.useEnvBody: Her own voice is removed from her settings, and she speaks with the one {env} sets: {value}.
voice.cleared: {name} now speaks with the environment's voice.
voice.modelHelp: Which Fish Audio model reads her lines.
voice.cueClash.title: {model} reads delivery cues aloud
voice.cueClash.body: This prompt teaches delivery cues, such as [whispering] or paired tags, which only {model} acts on. Other models speak them as words. Switch back to {model}, or take the cues out of the prompt.
voice.cueEnv.title: {model}, which she inherits from {env}, reads delivery cues aloud
voice.cueEnv.body: This prompt teaches delivery cues, such as [whispering] or paired tags, which only {model} acts on: other models speak them as words. Pick {model} for her here, or take the cues out of the prompt.
models.title: Models
models.description: The chat model she thinks with, and the speech model she hears you with.
memory.title: Memory
memory.description: What she remembers about you from one call to the next: the model that writes memories down, and how many she recalls each turn.
memory.off: Memory is off: it needs a Qdrant host, which you set in {settings}.
glossary.title: Glossary
glossary.description: Names and terms Soniox should hear right when it transcribes this persona's videos: her name, her fans', recurring topics. It is TOML in the shape of Soniox's StructuredContext, and videos transcribed after you save use it.
glossary.label: Glossary
glossary.refused: Not saved: this glossary doesn't parse
glossary.savedWithErrors: Glossary saved, but it doesn't parse yet.
facts.title: Facts
facts.description: Fact files hold what she knows about herself, one fact per line. Indexing them uses the embedding API, which bills a little.
facts.newNameHelp: A .txt file; .txt is added when you leave it out.
facts.badName: Use a plain file name ending in .txt, without / \ or :, that doesn't start with a dot.
facts.emptyBody: Add a .txt file of what she knows about herself, then index it. Files matching {patterns} are indexed.
facts.sheetHelp: One fact per line. A line may start with a date, such as 2024-05-01 or 2024年5月1日.
facts.deleteBody: The file is removed from your data home. Facts already indexed stay until you index again.
facts.ingestHelp: Every file is indexed as it is now.
facts.changedCount: {count} files changed since the last index.
facts.goneCount: {count} files were removed since the last index.
facts.goneTitle: Her index still has facts from {count} removed files
facts.goneBody: They were deleted, or no longer match the patterns. Index facts again so she forgets them:
facts.goneEmpty: No file is left for indexing to read, and it keeps her old facts until it has one. Add a fact file, then index facts again so she forgets these:
facts.nothingMatched: No file matches the patterns, so there is nothing to index.
index.title: Index
index.description: What calls search: her facts and her stream archive. Each table is rebuilt by its own job.
index.staleHelp: A table built with another embedding model or size than the settings now name can't be searched. Run its job again.
indexing.title: Indexing
indexing.description: What the index jobs read: which of her fact files, the pattern that names her in them, and the scene types left out of her stream archive. Index again after a change.
search.title: Search
search.description: How a call searches what she knows: how many candidates each index offers, the reranker that orders them, and the gate that skips the search when a turn isn't about her.
references.outfitsHelp: What she looks like in selfies. Each selfie redraws one outfit, picked by the hour.
references.outfitsEmpty: She can't take selfies without one. Add a picture of her, or drop one here.
references.local: Outfits you add stay on this computer: deploying {name} copies only her friends' pictures.
references.friendsHelp: People she can take a selfie with: one picture each, named after them.
references.friendsEmpty: Add a picture of someone she can take a selfie with, or drop one here.
references.friendHelp: The picture is saved under their name, which is how she knows who it is.
references.noPreview: No preview: only PNG, JPEG and WebP are shown here. Selfies still use it.
references.badType: Pictures must be PNG, JPEG or WebP.
references.badName: {name} isn't a usable file name. Rename the file without / \ or :, so that it doesn't start with a dot.
references.selfieHelp: The image model and how selfies are drawn.
videos.addHelp: Paste video links, or the link of a playlist, series or channel. Each link is checked first, so you see what it holds before anything downloads.
videos.scopeNote: She speaks Mandarin, so add Mandarin streams. For audio in another language, set it under Transcription below.
videos.invalidLinks: These lines aren't http or https links:
videos.previewUnknown: The length of {count} of them is unknown.
videos.previewDisk: Their audio needs about {size}; {free} is free.
videos.diskShort: There may not be enough free space for this audio. Free some space first, or add fewer videos.
videos.added: Added {count} videos in a new batch.
videos.addedSome: Added {count} videos in a new batch; {known} were listed already.
videos.allKnown: All of these videos are listed already.
videos.downloadHelp: yt-dlp downloads each video's audio into your data home. Nothing is billed.
videos.ytdlpFirst: yt-dlp installs itself on the first download.
videos.ytdlpManual: Install it yourself with brew install yt-dlp or pip install yt-dlp, and Eidolon uses the one on your PATH.
videos.ffmpegMissing: ffmpeg isn't installed. Only videos over 5 hours need it.
videos.ffmpegNeeded: ffmpeg isn't installed, and {count} videos are over 5 hours, which need it to be transcribed.
videos.ffmpegHint: macOS: brew install ffmpeg · Windows: winget install ffmpeg · Linux: your package manager's ffmpeg.
videos.freeSpace: {size} free on the data home's disk.
videos.freeUnknown: The free space on the data home's disk is unknown.
videos.cookiesDefault: Cookies come from Chrome, the default.
videos.cookiesHelp: Some videos need a signed-in browser's cookies. Reading a browser's cookies may ask for your password (the macOS Keychain), and yt-dlp writes the cookies it used back into a cookies file.
videos.cookiesTrouble: The last download failed on cookies. Pick another browser, a cookies file or none, then download again.
videos.notInBatch: These videos come from your own URL lists, which only laplace-pipeline in a terminal downloads.
videos.batchesWaiting: {count} batches are waiting; this downloads the oldest first.
videos.runHelp: Soniox transcribes the audio, the refine model cleans up each transcript, and the embedding API indexes it. Each step skips what's already done.
videos.nothingToRun: Nothing is left to transcribe, refine or index.
videos.estimateUnpriced: {count} videos can't be priced yet: their length is known only once they download.
videos.estimateNote: Estimates come from price tables or past runs, and leave out indexing's embedding cost.
videos.noDate: {count} downloaded videos have no upload date, so they wait until you give one in the table below.
videos.concurrencyHelp: Soniox allows up to {max} at once per account.
videos.runConfirmBody: This bills your Soniox, OpenRouter and embedding accounts: about {usd} by the estimate.
videos.tableHelp: Where each video stands by the latest plan, and what the running job is doing.
videos.planFailed: The plan couldn't be made. Its job page has the details.
transcription.title: Transcription
transcription.description: How her videos become transcripts: the language and model Soniox transcribes with, and the model that refines them, with how many chunks it works on at once.
table.empty: Add links above, and each video is listed here with where it stands.
table.unpriced: Its length is unknown until it downloads.
table.dateHelp: {video} has no upload date, which the stream archive orders by. Give the day it was streamed to transcribe it.
advanced.title: Advanced
advanced.description: Her settings the other sections don't show: where her prompt and index live, and the ids Mem0 files her memories under.
